entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is David. How can I help you today?
Yeah, David, I want to return these ridiculous cycling shoes I bought from you. They're complete garbage and I am not paying for them.
I'm certainly sorry to hear you're not happy with your purchase. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the cycling shoes?

The issue? THE ISSUE? They're unusable! I've adjusted the cleats a dozen times, and all I get are painful blisters on every single ride. I paid good money for these and they're destroying my feet. I want a full refund, and I want it now.

I can definitely understand your frustration. Getting blisters is absolutely not the experience we want for our customers. I can look into that return for you. Could I please get your full name and order number?

The name is Sam Jones. Order number is VF-8675309. And don't give me some long, drawn-out process. If you can't authorize this refund, you need to put your manager on the phone this instant. I am one step away from plastering a review about this all over the internet.
Thank you, Sam. I'm pulling up your account now... One moment. Okay, I see the order here for the cycling shoes, purchased about 83 days ago. Let me just check the policy.
You'd better. I'm not playing games here.
No games at all, Sam. I can see you are well within our 90-day return window. I can absolutely process this return for you immediately.
So you'll process the full refund? No restocking fee nonsense?

That's correct. A full refund, no fees. I'm generating a prepaid return label and I'll email it to you right now. Just pack the shoes in a box, attach the label, and drop it off. As soon as we receive it, the refund will be issued to your original form of payment.
Fine. Make sure that label gets to me.

It's already on its way to your inbox. And Sam, I can see you're a VIP customer with us, and we sincerely regret this frustrating experience. For the trouble with the blisters and your time today, I've also added a $25 VeloFit credit to your account for a future purchase. We want to make sure you find gear that works perfectly for you.
Oh. A credit? Okay... well, that's... that's good. I appreciate you doing that. Thank you.
You are very welcome. We value your business. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's all. Just make sure I get that refund.
It will be processed the moment the return is scanned into our warehouse. You have my word. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a better afternoon.
